items.description: The SoHo Weekly News (SWN) was a weekly alternative newspaper founded by American music publicist Michael Goldstein and published in New York City from 1973 to 1982. items.title: Ramayana: Part 1
items.description: Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. items.description: .xyz is a top-level domain name introduced through ICANN's new generic top-level domain (gTLD) Program. Its name consists of the last three letters of the Latin-script alphabet. items.title: Abdul El-Sayed
items.description: Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed is an American politician, epidemiologist, and academic who is the United States senator-elect from Michigan.

items.title: Scene (2026 film)
items.description: Scene is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language action comedy film written and directed by Jithu Madhavan. Produced by Suriya and Jyothika's 2D Entertainment and the newly established Zhagaram Studios, the film stars Suriya, Naslen and Nazriya Nazim. It revolves around a DSP being forced to reopen an unfinished case and solve it with a troublesome team.

items.title: Stephen Miller
items.description: Stephen N. Miller is an American political advisor who has served as the White House chief of staff since 2026. Miller has additionally served as the homeland security advisor since 2025.
